items.label: Question 14
items.why: Exothermic reactions release (give out) heat energy to the surroundings.
items.txt:
14. A reaction is exothermic if

  1. energy is absorbed from the surroundings
  2. energy is released to the surroundings
  3. energy is required to start the reaction
  4. there is no energy change.

items.label: Question 9
items.why: Complete combustion of a hydrocarbon in plenty of oxygen gives carbon dioxide and water.
items.txt:
9. When methane burns in a plentiful supply of air, the products are

  2. carbon dioxide and water
  3. carbon monoxide and water
  4. carbon dioxide and hydrogen.

items.label: Question 14
items.why: Endothermic reactions take in heat from the surroundings, so the temperature drops.
items.txt:
14. A reaction is endothermic if

  1. energy is required to start the reaction
  2. heat is released during the reaction
  3. the temperature drops during the reaction
  4. the temperature rises during the reaction.
